title: ai-writing-harness-overview-v2
brief: 基于参考图的初版 AI 写作全景图继续优化，不要完全重画成普通 SVG。目标是 README 顶部 hero / blog banner 风格的白色背景信息图，保留初版的中心 harness core、输入到输出、反馈闭环、模块化 automation control-room 感，但整体改成明亮、干净、专业、现代的技术信息图。主题是 writing-agent-harness：个人 AI 自动化写作工作台。画面需要中文为主的短标签和简短说明，清楚展示：输入入口（飞书、Notion、灵感碎片、网页研究、本地草稿）、AGENTS.md 路由、docs runbooks、project skills、canonical Markdown / MDX source、readiness / preview、微信公众号、博客、未来渠道、human final review、自我进化闭环（closeout、retrospectives、memory、docs 更新、skills 修复）。信息密度中等，适合 README 首屏，不要密密麻麻，不要小到看不清。视觉风格：flat-tech-infographic，白底或浅色纸面背景，柔和蓝绿橙点缀，清晰模块、箭头、分组容器、小图标，中文标签尽量准确可读。避免：深色背景、纯装饰科幻感、聊天机器人形象、过多英文、过度复杂的流程线、错误或乱码文字。
prompt:
Create a polished article illustration titled 'ai-writing-harness-overview-v2'. Diagram type: blog banner. Use a flat technical infographic illustration, clean grouped modules, clear arrows, soft professional palette, concise bilingual labels, document-friendly composition. Make it suitable for insertion into engineering notes or a design document. Prefer a clear information hierarchy with section titles, concise Chinese/English labels, short notes, arrows, grouped modules, and strong readability. Avoid dense paragraph blocks. Language mode: zh. Target aspect ratio preset: blog-banner. Mode: reference+text. Use the provided reference image or images only for style guidance such as palette, line quality, spacing, icon treatment, and annotation tone. Do not copy their literal subject matter.
